title: Neither the nuclear option nor DCS was available on Mac...
author: -logic--
selftext:
So I made this in Unity. Land, air, and sea. Started with real units and munitions. But when i thought about licences and publishing, I switched to a nuclear-option-style, near-future fictional planes, vehicles and ships. Same with munitions (though the real units are still in the game i just have to figure out whether/how to publish them)

The mechanics are quite detailed. Radar behaves accurately (you can Doppler notch, you can jam; there is attitude-dependent RCS, etc.). There are various kinds of seekers. Anti-radiation, IR, radar, GPS, visual. There is a datalink, \~accurate energy tradeoff in missile guidance and dogfighting.

All models visible in this trailer were generated using Claude (and Astra for the munitions

There are a bunch of 4th-, 5th-, and 6th-gen jets, drones (CCAs and Predator-style), transport aircraft, and AWACS. There's a frigate, a big destroyer, an America-class-style carrier, an unmanned missile truck ship with a lot of VLCs and a "q-ship" (secretly, heavily armed container ship). There are 4 helis (2 attack, 1 transport and one naval drone-heli). For ground vehicles, there is an MBT, an IFV, a big UGV, the whole spectrum of air defence vehicles (close- to long-range and the radar and command vehicles for those batteries), a drone carrier, missile- and barrel-based artillery.

All of the models are available on Sketchfab here, fully textured and rigged:  
[https://sketchfab.com/hannes.thurnherr/models](https://sketchfab.com/hannes.thurnherr/models)

You can control all of them, but I put most of the effort into the aircraft experience and it shows.

The landscape started with real terrain using Caesium ion, but I switched to a \~small continent-sized procedurally generated map based on erosion simulation. It has mountains, deserts, coastal regions, villages, towns, big cities, a road network, power lines, wind mills, and hydro-power dams, oil infrastructure (including drilling, tankers and refineries), army bases, airbases, naval bases and civil airports. The house generation code is mostly aimed at matching the distribution of medium-sized Swiss towns. There is foliage, including forests and agricultural plants. (Regrettably, the terrain is like 60 GB lol)

Any feedback? After looking at it for so long, I have lost the ability to compare. Would you want (or even pay for) something like this?

comments.author: super3
comments.body: I think it looks cool. I'd play it but I wouldn't pay for it vs a polished game.

comments.author: Aeweisafemalesheep
comments.body: But does it use secret documents and drunken conversations with top tier pilots?
